enrollment.provider: Washington Office of Superintendent of Public Instruction
enrollment.policy: Do not substitute another enrollment measure if historical AAFTE coverage is unavailable; document and fail.

series.caution: Local-area CPI has a smaller sample and is more volatile than the national index; retain as a parallel local inflation lens.

inflation.policy: Both CPI series are required and produce separately named constant-dollar outputs; neither fills gaps in the other.
